evals.expected_output: One story with scope tiers, single-criterion ACs and both Gherkin poles.
assertions: Writes positive and negative scenarios; the negative ones show the guardrail refusing
Each AC states one observable condition
Scope items carry Must-have, Nice-to-have or Out of scope
Adds a version AC and a version scenario pair, since the policy set is pinned

evals.prompt: Draft four stories from these findings and rank them. The platform owner wants logging first; the head of operations wants disaster recovery first; the audit deadline is 30 Nov 2026.

assertions: Names both positions and the governing constraint, the audit deadline
Does not collapse the disagreement into one ranking without saying so
